data.title: 红月卡莲 · 训练过后的温润红晕
data.description: 水汽氤氲的洗浴间门边，刚结束格斗训练的卡莲换上轻便丝质睡衣，湿润的红发发尾贴在雪白锁骨上，有些害羞地避开视线又忍不住偷瞄。
data.action: relaxed silk camisole, wet hair, flushed face, shy cute sideways glance
data.lighting: soft diffused warm lighting through lingering shower steam
data.promptProse: Standing in a softly misted room in light silk loungewear, Kallen Kouzuki brushes wet red strands from her flushed cheek, glancing aside with a shy, captivating blush.
data.animaCaption: Kallen with blushing cheeks in a steamy room after shower.
